name: Ricardo Sepúlveda
bio:
Ricardo's journey into motorsport was somewhat accidental. After a career as a diesel mechanic, a chance encounter with a Formula racing team during a cross-country rally sparked his interest. He was fascinated by the engineering and technology that underpinned the sport. He started as a general assistant, before eventually transitioning into wind tunnel operations, drawn to the meticulous nature of data analysis and its immediate impact on vehicle performance.

Ricardo brings a practical, hands-on approach to his work. While not formally trained in aerodynamics, his deep understanding of mechanical systems allows him to quickly identify potential issues and propose practical solutions. He is eager to learn and improve his skills, constantly seeking advice from more experienced colleagues and devouring technical manuals in his spare time. He considers himself a very loyal and dedicated employee.

His ambition is to become the most knowledgeable wind tunnel operator in the team, contributing significantly to the car's aerodynamic development and ultimately helping the team achieve championship success.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part
physical.description: Ricardo is of medium height with a sturdy build, reflecting his years of working with heavy machinery.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical diagrams and notes.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when concentrating.
Insists on brewing his own mate tea every afternoon, sharing it with colleagues.
